group:paper-mock-shanxi-taiyuan-2025-m1:.overview: 文章谈“睡前拖延”：忙碌一天的人舍不得睡，熬夜刷手机，第二天疲惫又陷入循环。作者给出三条建议：把自我时间提前、别在床上消磨时间、建立放松的睡前程序，并提醒改变贵在坚持。
group:paper-mock-shanxi-taiyuan-2025-m1:.fullTranslationZh:
如何改掉睡前拖延的习惯
当我洗完碗、打扫完客厅、发出当晚最后一封工作邮件后，就到了“属于自己”的时间。残酷的是，这也正是该睡觉的时间。我知道自己应该睡了，却总是在抖音上刷屏到很晚。这是我唯一不被打扰的时间，我想把它用足。这种现象被称为“睡前拖延”。白天压力大、几乎无法掌控自己时间的人最容易陷入这种情况。然而，睡前拖延的人第二天往往筋疲力尽，从而陷入恶性循环。下面这些建议能帮你重新掌控睡眠。
把“属于自己”的时间提前。虽然未必人人都做得到，但可以考虑把照顾自己的事挪到白天早些时候。投资一台高端洗碗机，挤出时间做一节简短的瑜伽；或者在每周安排里加入“周日备餐”，这样每个工作日晚上本要花在做饭上的时间就省回来了。
别赖在床上。无论工作日还是周末，你在床上刷手机、看电视，都是在训练大脑，让它以为这就是你在床上该做的事。好的做法是把床只留给睡觉，尤其是在你晚上难以入睡的时候。
建立一套放松的睡前程序。建一套让你期待的程序：练瑜伽、洗个热水澡或听有声书——关键是做你觉得最能让自己平静、最享受的事。专家还建议晚饭后马上洗脸刷牙。这样等你困了，上床就不那么费劲了。
一定要记住，克服睡前拖延追求的不是完美，而是进步。小而持续的改变，日积月累会带来显著的改善。无论你正受睡眠问题还是精神压力困扰，解决睡前拖延都可能让情况彻底改观。今晚就开始吧：定一个合理的就寝时间，并坚持下去。将来那个睡足了觉的你会感谢现在的自己。

completedSourceTexts.text: When I have done the dishes, cleaned the living room, and shot off my last work email of the night, it is “me” time. It is also, cruelly, bedtime. I know I should sleep, but instead I stay up way too late scrolling (滚屏) on TikTok. This is my only uninterrupted time. I want to maximize it. Such a phenomenon is called “bedtime procrastination”. People with stressful days and little control over their time are those who are most likely to fall into that category. However, all too often, bedtime procrastinators end up exhausted the next day, thus sinking into a terrible cycle. Here are some tips to regain control of your sleep.

· Move up your “me” time. Although this might not be possible for everyone, consider shifting your self-care tasks to an earlier time in the day. Invest in a high-end dishwasher to get in a quick yoga session, or include meal preparation Sundays in your weekly routine so you can get the hours back that you would have spent cooking each weeknight.

· Don’t hang out in bed. When you scroll on your phone or watch TV in bed, weekdays or weekends, you’re training your brain to think that’s what you’re supposed to do in bed. A good choice is to reserve your bed for sleep, especially if you struggle to fall asleep at night.

· Create a relaxing bedtime routine. Create one that you look forward to. Practice yoga, take a warm shower, or listen to an audiobook – the key is to do whatever you find most calming and enjoyable. Experts also recommend washing your face and brushing your teeth, right after dinner. Then it won’t be such an effort to get into bed when you feel sleepy.

Do remember, overcoming bedtime procrastination is not about perfection, but progress. Small but consistent changes bring significant improvements over time. Whether you’re struggling with sleep problems or mental stress, addressing sleep procrastination can be a game-changer. Start tonight by setting a reasonable bedtime and sticking to it. Your future, well-rested self will thank you.
